title: Futa Witch Elves 1.5.0
author: DeHess
description:
Features:

-
Reskin / Kitbash of Hellebron, Death Hags, Witch Elves and Sisters of Slaughter, they now have glorious dicks.

-
New expendable slave unit recruitable from the slave pen building. These slaves have been captured and broken by the Witch Elves and are now used as combat fodder.

-
New Witch Elf variant: Witch Elves (Glaives), a fast anti-large option.

-
New Lord: Death Hag Matriarch. So that you can have futas leading your armies, not just death hag heroes.

-
Some powerful new skills for Death Hags / Death Hag Matriarch / Hellebron

Assets used:

-
Dick models: Community Beastmen mod by Rielle, Sewerrat, Endo etc.

-
Buff Witch Elf Models: Cullbridegoth mod series by delcastillokenneth1

Support:

I will no longer support the reskin-only version. There may be issues with that specific version, but the complete version will be kept updated.

Otherwise, I am open to new ideas, just write a comment.
